responsibility: This file provides the GNU C front end’s language-specific `convert` routine for converting expression trees between C types before gimplification. It dispatches conversions according to destination tree code—integers, booleans, pointers, reals, fixed-point, complex, vectors, and compatible aggregates—consults target hooks for invalid or target-specific conversions, inserts sanitizer instrumentation for floating-to-integer casts when enabled, and returns folded conversion trees in the canonical forms expected by the middle end and neighboring C type-checking code.
